sloka: तौ तु तत्र महारण्ये ववृधाते महौजसौ ।कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ लोकोद्वेगकरौ तदा ।। ७.९.३७ ॥
transliteration: tau tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhāte mahaujasau ।kumbhakarṇadaśagrīvau lokodvegakarau tadā ।। 7.9.37 ॥

translations.english: Then, those two, Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, grew up in that great forest, becoming exceedingly powerful and a cause of distress to the world.
